title: Empirical acceptance criteria for the gcd (property-tested by tools/property_backend.py)

obligations.intent_statement: The result is a common divisor of both inputs.
assumptions: inputs are sampled in 1..40, inside the contract precondition (at least one input positive); gcd(0, 0) stays undefined

obligations.intent_statement: A common divisor of positive inputs is never larger than either input.
assumptions: inputs are sampled in 1..40, so both are positive and the postcondition of GCD-02 (result >= 1) holds on the sample
